ordered_follow.meaning: Following enters the existing FIFO queue after ordinary commands; takeover tools supersede pending follow intent without dropping preceding work or replaying an owned exit.
review_fixes: Superseded discovery cannot submit follow activation when service appears later.

limitations: Low-level interactive_action still requires its projected trick; it is not a following-takeover tool.
Browser following preflight can stop following before a later invalid motion is rejected.

late_failure_feedback.meaning: Track actual accepted job IDs across the spoken turn, then match fresh server/epoch terminal failed outcomes. Existing status polling emits one approved cached Pupper failure cue; no success-completion speech or cloud TTS fallback.

late_failure_feedback.limits: Operator correction only; does not synchronize model conversation memory or prove physical completion. Live audibility/robot acceptance pending.
late_failure_feedback.concurrency: Pause later model actions; use existing automatic Stop only if another model action POST is already in flight.
